watches.name: CLASSICO 42 - BROWN LEATHER
watches.description: Clean. Confident. Timeless. The Classico 42 is a modern dress watch built around understated elegance. Its clean White dial, polished case, and refined proportions create a timeless silhouette that feels equally at home in the office, at dinner, or on the weekend. Designed with balance and versatility in mind, every detail has been carefully considered, from the applied markers to the slim profile and leather strap. The result is a watch that complements your style without demanding attention. Powered by a precision-engineered quartz movement, the Classico 42 delivers dependable, accurate timekeeping with minimal maintenance, making it the perfect everyday companion. Technical Details Case Size: 42mm Strap Size: 22mm Movement: Precision Quartz Movement Water Resistance: 30ft Warranty: Two-Year Limited Materials Case: High-Polish Strap: Leather Crystal: Heat-Treated Mineral Crystal Dial: Textured Finish

watches.name: MAVENTUS MONTÉNOIR CLASSIC
watches.description: Clean. Confident. Timeless. The Maventus Monténoir Classic is designed for those who believe true luxury speaks quietly. Featuring a refined matte finish dial, brushed and polished finishes, and a bold integrated silhouette, it delivers effortless sophistication without unnecessary distraction. Whether you're in the boardroom, out for dinner, or traveling the world, this timepiece adapts seamlessly to every occasion. Its balanced proportions, premium materials, and automatic movement create a timepiece that's built to be worn every day and appreciated for years to come. Powered by the Automatic Cal.2915 Movement, it never requires a battery, harnessing the natural motion of your wrist to keep perfect time. watches.name: MAVENTUS PLATINUM SKELETON
watches.description: Bold engineering meets timeless craftsmanship. The Maventus Platinum Skeleton is built for those who appreciate the mechanics behind every second. Its fully skeletonized dial showcases the intricate movement beneath, transforming the watch into a living piece of engineering. Brushed and polished steel and metal surfaces create striking contrast, while the integrated design delivers a bold, confident presence on the wrist. Designed to transition effortlessly from the office to weekends away, it is a statement of precision, versatility, and modern luxury. Every detail has been carefully refined, creating a timepiece that is as captivating to admire as it is to wear. Powered by the Automatic Cal.2915 Movement , this watch never needs a battery, drawing its energy from the natural motion of your wrist.
